name: 松仔
evolution: 松仔 → 松叶羊 Lv.16 → 针叶巡林 Lv.36
description: 如果察觉到小洛克踏入森林，它们会把角塞在树杈中间伪装松果，诱使小洛克靠近观察。被林间露水打湿的话它们会结伴去晒太阳，晒太阳的时候会散发香香的味道。
descriptionEn: If it notices a Locke stepping into the forest, they tuck their horns between branches to disguise as pinecones, luring the Locke to come closer and observe. If dampened by forest dew, they go sunbathe together, giving off a fragrant smell while basking.
